replication.target_description: Replication of the coded claim that GAD participants respond faster to angry than neutral central faces. The omnibus Group x Valence interaction does not establish the focal within-GAD contrast; target-test correspondence remains unresolved.

n.sample_role: Participant analytic N for focal within-GAD contrast unresolved.
n.exclusions: Not documented in supplied report text.
n.location: Claim evaluation, Simple test; Description of materials provided

es.quote: Unlike Yiend et al., no Group x Valence of Face interaction was observed, F (4, 390) = .02, η2p < .000.

p.quote: Results: Follow up one-way ANOVAs were run for sake of replication, the “focal hypothesized finding” was not observed, notable results are detailed below:

notes: Identity assessment: supplied text identifies SCORE Report - Yiend_ClinPsychSci_2015_LmBx - Wilbiks - y2gz6.docx, replication team Jordan MacDonald, Jonathan Wilbiks, Mok Lee, SCORE RR ID y2gz6 and OSF Project https://osf.io/p2st5. Project, claim and report identifiers match the assigned replication. The neutral reference lists project contributors rather than the report team. Original title and DOI 10.1177/2167702614545216 match, with 2015 in the report reference versus 2014 in the input. Accepted as a primary replication report parsed from DOCX; no PDF supplied. The report names separate full-results PDF, script and data files; these were not supplied for inspection. The coded claim identifies the GAD angry-versus-neutral central-face reaction-time contrast, independently of row order or numeric matching. Printed omnibus candidates only: Group F (2, 390) = .12, η2p = .001; Valence F (2, 390) = .07, η2p < .000; interaction F (4, 390) = .02, η2p < .000. These do not resolve the focal contrast, and are not entered as its effect. No effect conversion, p calculation or N inference from df was performed. No explicit final group counts support an analytic N sum. Reported significance criteria are not observed p values. The missing-supplement dispositions describe the supplied report limitation, not absence from the full study. Original side and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
